mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tbl_auth_token_session ( session_id, user_account_id, username, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, access_token_expires_at, refresh_token_expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{sessionId}, #{userAccountId}, #{username}, #{accessTokenHash}, #{refreshTokenHash}, #{accessTokenExpiresAt}, #{refreshTokenExpiresAt}, #{revokedAt}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, now()), COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, now()) )
mapper.select: SELECT session_id, user_account_id, username, access_token_hash, refresh_token_hash, access_token_expires_at, refresh_token_expires_at, revoked_at, created_at, updated_at FROM tbl_auth_token_session WHERE access_token_hash = #{accessTokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND access_token_expires_at > #{now}
